newsitem.title: UK: GE Capital makes agreed offer for CTR.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital makes agreed offer for CTR.

text.p: GE Capital, a subsidiary of General Electric Co, said on Tuesday that it has made a recommended offer for Central Transport Rental Group Plc (CTR), valuing the company at about 118 million stg.
The offer is 16p for each CTR share and 48p for each CTR ADS, representing a premium of about 129 percent over CTR's ordinary shares on July 28.
GE, a diversified financial services company, already has acceptances for the offer representing 44.5 percent of the trailer rental company's issued share capital.
GE said that the acquisition will benefit the customers of its subsidiary TIP Europe, a commercial trailer rental, leasing and sales company.
CTR operates 132 depots, with a total fleet of about 22,500 trailers, in nine European countries. It had total net assets of 307.7 million stg on April 30, 1997.
